notes: Spine: HYP -> base+Ca -> cast -> Al2Ca identity/distribution -> alpha-Mg rod->granular; parallel branch cast -> extrude -> Al2Ca dispersed in alpha and beta -> beta grains 10.3->4.6 um; E2EM matching (STR/interface, argued) -> heterogeneous nucleation MEC explains both refinements -> conclusion. No PRP or PRF stage: the packet contains no property or performance data, so the spine ends STR -> MEC -> DSC. Audits: n2 (F1a lath widths ~15-40 um contradict the stated 322.61 um width and 1371.56 um length exceeds the field), n8 (EDS Mg/Al unresolved, particle below interaction volume), l1 (etchant limitation). Packet issues: F1a/F1b and F4c/F4d carry printed labels but are listed annotated: false; F4b has no A/B point markers although the caption refers to them; captions say 'now resolution' for 'low resolution'; F3 technique unstated.
